events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: A Very British Icon
angles.copy: Bringing us laughter for decades, the inimitable John Cleese is 87 today. Which of his iconic roles is your all-time favourite?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, iconic 'White Album'. Which track still gets you every time?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45. He would have been 80 in 2026.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today, 35 years since we lost a true rock icon. His voice, his stage presence, simply unforgettable.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was first released in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly pushed boundaries. What's your standout track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of The Beatles icon, John Lennon, who was tragically killed on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40. He would have been 86 in 2026.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, 46 years since the world lost a musical visionary. His legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician David Bowie was born on January 8, 1947, and would have been 80 years old today.

angles.name: Celebrating an Icon
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman, David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. His impact on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on January 8, 1935, and would have been 92 years old today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. Which of his hits is your go-to?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock God Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his riffs defined generations. What's your favourite Pagey moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Still Rockin' Rod
angles.copy: The one and only Rod Stewart turns 82 today! Still got that signature rasp and stage swagger. What's your favourite Rod tune?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Suggs (Graham McPherson), the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs from Madness! Still bringing the house down with those classic hits. What's your favourite Madness moment?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: 80s Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to the voice behind so many 80s classics, Paul Young! What's your go-to track for a bit of 'Wherever I Lay My Hat'?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton was born on January 19, 1946, and would have been 81 years old today.

angles.name: Celebrating a Queen
angles.copy: On what would have been her 81st birthday, we're celebrating the one and only Dolly Parton. A true icon whose music and spirit shine bright.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to Take That's Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to musical theatre, what's your favourite Gary moment?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams and into our cars, his hits are timeless. What's your favourite?

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction (1989)
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 24, 1989, honouring pioneers like Chuck Berry, James Brown, Elvis Presley, and Little Richard.

angles.name: Rock History Made
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame inducted its first legends. Who do you think was the most deserving of that inaugural class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still got that boyish charm. What's your favourite Mark Owen era?

events.title: The Beatles' rooftop concert (1969)
events.blurb: On January 30, 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final live public performance on the rooftop of their Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Iconic Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Iconic singer-songwriter and Genesis drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Drum Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo superstardom, his hits are truly 'In The Air Tonight'.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: British Charm Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to the king of charming awkwardness, Hugh Grant! Which of his classic rom-coms is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Prince Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From *NSYNC to solo smash hits, he's still bringing 'SexyBack'. What's your favourite JT track?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure and acclaimed actor Sir David Jason, known for Only Fools and Horses and A Touch of Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National Treasure Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true icon of British television. What's your favourite Del Boy moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died (1959)
events.blurb: Today marks the 68th anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash on February 3, 1959.

angles.name: Remembering the Legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in 'The Day The Music Died'. Their impact on rock and roll is eternal.
